title: Year-end closing

years.empty: No financial years have been synced from Fortnox yet.

neverSynced: The ledger has not been synced

evidence.disagreesHint: The app exported a voucher with this number, but the amounts do not agree. The number may have been reused in Fortnox after a voucher was deleted.

voucher.noneBody: The app holds no evidence for this voucher. It was booked directly in Fortnox, so its evidence is there or somewhere else.
voucher.receipts: {count, plural, =0 {(no receipts)} one {(# receipt)} other {(# receipts)}}
voucher.reviewFailed: The review could not be saved
voucher.commentFailed: The comment could not be sent
voucher.commentPlaceholder: Write a question or an answer

review.title: Review

status.changedHint: The voucher has changed in Fortnox since it was reviewed, or its number has been given to another voucher. It needs reviewing again.
status.QUESTION: Question

review.openQuestions: {count, plural, one {# open question} other {# open questions}}
review.orphaned: {count, plural, one {One review is for a voucher} other {# reviews are for vouchers}} no longer in the ledger. They may have been deleted in Fortnox.
review.history: {count, plural, one {Show history (# review)} other {Show history (# reviews)}}

flag.outsideYearHint: The voucher is dated outside the financial year.
flag.possibleDuplicateHint: Another voucher on the same day has the same amount.
flag.deadlineWaivedHint: The expense was filed after the deadline on an exemption.
flag.ownBookingHint: The same person booked and posted the expense.

checklist.notStarted: The checklist has not been started
checklist.notStartedBody: Start it when the closing begins. It is copied from the template as it is then, and what last year wrote to this year is shown on each item.
checklist.startFailed: The checklist could not be started
checklist.noteHint: What was done this year, for whoever reads the closing afterwards.
checklist.noteToNextYearHint: What the next treasurer needs to know. Shown on the same item next year.

accounts.empty: The ledger has no balance accounts with a balance for the year.
accounts.accountNoteHint: What the account is and how it is reconciled. Applies to every year.
accounts.noteHint: Anything worth knowing about this year's reconciliation.

template.title: Checklist template
template.intro: The steps every year's checklist starts from. A year already started does not change when the template does.
template.offset: {days, plural, =0 {Last day of the year} =1 {1 day after year end} =-1 {1 day before year end} other {{days} days from year end}}

field.title: Title
field.howToHint: Where in Fortnox, which evidence is needed, what tends to go wrong.
field.dueOffsetDaysHint: Negative is before. Empty for no date.
field.dueOffsetDaysInvalid: A whole number, for example 14 or -21
field.checkHint: Leave empty to tick it off by hand.
